senses.en: a government department responsible for a particular area
senses.pattern: a government agency / a space agency / an environmental protection agency
senses.example: The national weather [[agency]] warned that the typhoon could bring record rainfall to the east coast.
senses.example_zh: 國家氣象署警告，這個颱風可能為東岸帶來破紀錄的雨量。

senses.en: the ability to act and make your own choices
senses.pattern: a sense of agency / human agency / moral agency
senses.example: Letting students choose their own research topics gives them a stronger sense of [[agency]] in learning.
senses.example_zh: 讓學生自選研究主題，能增強他們在學習上的自主性。

gsat.sentence: Environmental Protection [[Agency]] (EPA), medical waste is a major source of dioxin pollution in the country.

senses.en: to stop or slow down a process
senses.pattern: arrest the decline / arrest the spread of a disease / arrest the development of
senses.example: Doctors hope the new treatment can [[arrest]] the spread of the infection before it reaches the lungs.
senses.example_zh: 醫生希望新療法能在感染蔓延到肺部之前抑制其擴散。

senses.en: to catch and hold someone's attention
senses.pattern: arrest sb's attention / arrest the eye / arrest sb's gaze
senses.example: A huge painting of a blue whale [[arrested]] the attention of everyone entering the museum hall.
senses.example_zh: 一幅巨大的藍鯨畫作吸引了所有走進博物館大廳的人的注意。

senses.en: to officially prevent someone from doing something
senses.pattern: bar sb from doing sth / be barred from entering / bar sb's way
senses.example: After the cheating scandal, the two players were [[barred]] from competing in any national tournament for a year.
senses.example_zh: 作弊醜聞爆發後，這兩名選手一年內被禁止參加任何全國性賽事。

senses.en: a long piece of metal in a cage or window
senses.pattern: the bars of a cage / iron bars / behind bars
senses.example: The little monkey reached through the [[bars]] of its cage to grab a banana from the keeper.
senses.example_zh: 小猴子把手伸出籠子的鐵條，從飼養員手中抓走一根香蕉。

gsat.sentence: When photographing zoo animals, don’t get too close to the cages, and never tap on the glass or throw things between the [[bars]] of a cage.

senses.en: not noticing or refusing to notice something
senses.pattern: be blind to the risks / be blind to one's faults / turn a blind eye to
senses.example: Many parents are [[blind]] to their own children's faults and blame the school for every problem.
senses.example_zh: 許多父母對自己孩子的缺點視而不見，把所有問題都怪到學校頭上。
senses.note: 名詞 blinds 指「百葉窗」

senses.en: to stop someone from thinking or judging clearly
senses.pattern: be blinded by love / be blinded by anger / blind sb to the truth
senses.example: The company's early success [[blinded]] its managers to the fact that customers' tastes were changing.
senses.example_zh: 公司早期的成功蒙蔽了經理人，使他們看不出顧客的喜好正在改變。

senses.en: the group of top ministers who lead a government
senses.pattern: a cabinet minister / a cabinet meeting / a cabinet reshuffle / form a cabinet
senses.example: The new prime minister chose experts rather than party members to serve in her [[cabinet]].
senses.example_zh: 新任首相挑選專家而非黨內成員進入她的內閣。

senses.en: happening by accident, not planned
senses.pattern: a chance meeting / a chance encounter / a chance discovery / a chance remark
senses.example: A [[chance]] meeting on a train led the two scientists to work together for twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 火車上的一次偶然相遇，讓這兩位科學家合作了二十年。

senses.en: to do or find something by accident
senses.pattern: chance upon sth / chance on an old friend / chance to do sth
senses.example: While cleaning the attic, I [[chanced]] upon a box of letters my grandfather wrote during the war.
senses.example_zh: 打掃閣樓時，我偶然發現一箱祖父在戰時寫的信。

senses.en: to move forward without using power
senses.pattern: coast downhill / coast along / coast to a stop
senses.example: We stopped pedaling and let our bikes [[coast]] down the long hill toward the lake.
senses.example_zh: 我們停止踩踏，讓腳踏車順著長長的下坡朝湖邊滑行。

senses.en: to succeed without making much effort
senses.pattern: coast to victory / coast through the exam / coast into the final
senses.example: The defending champions [[coasted]] to victory, scoring five goals without ever looking tired.
senses.example_zh: 衛冕隊輕鬆取得勝利，攻進五球卻始終不見疲態。

senses.en: the amount of a substance in a liquid or mixture
senses.pattern: a high concentration of salt / carbon dioxide concentration / blood sugar concentration
senses.example: The [[concentration]] of salt in the Dead Sea is so high that swimmers float easily.
senses.example_zh: 死海的鹽濃度非常高，游泳的人很容易就能浮起來。

senses.en: a large number of things gathered in one place
senses.pattern: a concentration of factories / the concentration of wealth / a heavy concentration of
senses.example: The city has the highest [[concentration]] of bookstores in the country, with over forty on one street.
senses.example_zh: 這座城市是全國書店最密集的地方，光是一條街就有四十多家。

gsat.sentence: They found that lowering GABA levels in zebrafish can trigger retina regeneration, while a high level of GABA [[concentration]] will suppress the regeneration process.

senses.en: to force someone into a place with no escape
senses.pattern: corner a suspect / feel cornered / a cornered animal
senses.example: The security guards finally [[cornered]] the thief in the parking garage, where he had nowhere to run.
senses.example_zh: 警衛終於在停車場把小偷逼入絕境，讓他無處可逃。

senses.en: to control the whole supply of a product
senses.pattern: corner the market / corner the market in sth / corner the supply of
senses.example: By buying every small rival, the firm has nearly [[cornered]] the market in organic tea.
senses.example_zh: 藉由收購所有小型對手，這家公司幾乎壟斷了有機茶市場。

senses.en: to have existed since a particular time
senses.pattern: date back to the 12th century / date from 1850 / date back centuries
senses.example: The stone bridge in the village [[dates]] back to the Roman period and is still used today.
senses.example_zh: 村裡的這座石橋可追溯至羅馬時期，至今仍在使用。

senses.en: to work out how old something is
senses.pattern: date a fossil / date the painting to 1600 / carbon dating
senses.example: Scientists [[dated]] the bones to about thirty thousand years ago by measuring the carbon they contained.
senses.example_zh: 科學家測量骨頭中的碳含量，鑑定出其年代約為三萬年前。

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is documented reference to the ringing of bells even before the cathedral’s construction was completed, [[dating]] as far back as the 12th century.
The idea of Blue Monday [[dates]] back to a 2005 campaign by Sky Travel.

senses.en: a wide difference between two groups
senses.pattern: the digital divide / the urban-rural divide / a cultural divide / bridge the divide
senses.example: The survey revealed a widening [[divide]] between rich and poor families in access to private tutoring.
senses.example_zh: 調查顯示，富裕與貧窮家庭在補習資源上的落差日益擴大。

senses.en: careful use of money, fuel, or time
senses.pattern: fuel economy / for reasons of economy / economy class
senses.example: Hybrid cars are popular with commuters because of their excellent fuel [[economy]] in city traffic.
senses.example_zh: 油電混合車很受通勤族歡迎，因為在市區行駛時十分節省燃油。

senses.en: a country seen as an economic system
senses.pattern: an emerging economy / a developing economy / the world's largest economies
senses.example: India is now one of the fastest-growing major [[economies]] in the world.
senses.example_zh: 印度現在是全球成長最快的主要經濟體之一。

gsat.sentence: Pacific islands like the Galápagos, Easter Island, and Tahiti, have [[economies]] that are driven almost completely by tourism.

senses.en: to show a quality, feeling, or sign clearly
senses.pattern: exhibit symptoms / exhibit signs of stress / exhibit a trait / exhibit behavior
senses.example: Children who grow up with pets often [[exhibit]] greater kindness toward animals later in life.
senses.example_zh: 從小與寵物一起長大的孩子，日後往往對動物表現出更多的善意。

senses.en: an object shown to the public in a museum
senses.pattern: a museum exhibit / the exhibits on display / an interactive exhibit
senses.example: Visitors are asked not to touch the [[exhibits]], some of which are over two thousand years old.
senses.example_zh: 參觀者請勿觸摸展品，其中有些已有兩千多年的歷史。

gsat.sentence: If neither of the parents has dimple genes, their children will not [[exhibit]] the trait.
It must be free from impurity, while [[exhibiting]] some fruitiness and creating a pleasant bitter flavor along with a peppery sensation in the mouth.

senses.en: food given to farm animals
senses.pattern: animal feed / cattle feed / feed for livestock
senses.example: Rising corn prices have made animal [[feed]] much more expensive for local pig farmers.
senses.example_zh: 玉米價格上漲，使當地養豬戶的動物飼料成本大幅增加。

senses.en: to put something into a machine or system
senses.pattern: feed data into a computer / feed paper into the printer / feed coins into a machine
senses.example: The researchers [[fed]] ten years of weather data into the computer to predict future floods.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員把十年的氣象資料輸入電腦，以預測未來的水患。

senses.en: to make a feeling or problem grow stronger
senses.pattern: feed fears / feed rumors / feed sb's anger / feed an addiction
senses.example: False reports on social media only [[fed]] people's fears about the safety of the new vaccine.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的不實報導只是助長了民眾對新疫苗安全性的恐懼。

gsat.sentence: It may replace [[feed]] for livestock.
Dioxin travels by air currents and settles onto grass, which is then eaten by cows and chickens in their [[feed]].

senses.en: because (used in formal writing)
senses.pattern: …, for it was getting dark / …, for he had no choice
senses.example: The villagers decided to leave at once, [[for]] the river was rising faster than expected.
senses.example_zh: 村民決定立刻離開，因為河水上漲得比預期還快。
senses.note: 書面語；前有逗號，不置於句首

senses.en: considering what is normal for someone or something
senses.pattern: tall for his age / warm for January / not bad for a beginner
senses.example: Your little brother is remarkably tall [[for]] his age; he looks like a junior high student.
senses.example_zh: 就他的年齡而言，你弟弟長得特別高，看起來像個國中生。

senses.en: in support of or in favor of
senses.pattern: be for the plan / for or against / vote for the proposal / be all for it
senses.example: Are you [[for]] or against the proposal to start school one hour later?
senses.example_zh: 你贊成還是反對把上學時間延後一小時的提案？

gsat.sentence: Brahma thought for a long time and finally decided to hide their divinity in the center of their own being, for humans would never think to look [[for]] it there.

senses.en: something done to show a feeling or intention
senses.pattern: a gesture of goodwill / a kind gesture / a gesture of support / a symbolic gesture
senses.example: As a [[gesture]] of thanks, the villagers sent baskets of fruit to the rescue team.
senses.example_zh: 村民送了好幾籃水果給救難隊，作為感謝的表示。

senses.en: to pay to use something for a short time
senses.pattern: hire a car / hire a bike / hire a boat / hire a hall
senses.example: We [[hired]] two bicycles at the station and spent the afternoon riding around the lake.
senses.example_zh: 我們在車站租用了兩輛腳踏車，花了一個下午繞湖騎行。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多用 rent

senses.en: a person who has just been given a job
senses.pattern: a new hire / recent hires / train new hires
senses.example: Every new [[hire]] at the hospital must complete a week of safety training before seeing patients.
senses.example_zh: 醫院的每位新進員工都必須完成一週的安全訓練，才能接觸病患。

gsat.sentence: Stretch limousines were [[hired]] to drive the prom-goers to expensive restaurants or discos for an all-night extravaganza.

senses.en: (of knowledge) very detailed and thorough
senses.pattern: an intimate knowledge of / an intimate understanding of / an intimate acquaintance with
senses.example: After thirty years as a tour guide, Mr. Lin has an [[intimate]] knowledge of the old city's back streets.
senses.example_zh: 當了三十年導遊，林先生對舊城區的大街小巷有極為詳盡的了解。

senses.en: (of a place or event) small, quiet, and friendly
senses.pattern: an intimate restaurant / an intimate atmosphere / an intimate gathering
senses.example: The singer prefers small, [[intimate]] concert halls where she can see every face in the audience.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手偏好小而溫馨私密的音樂廳，在那裡她能看見每一位觀眾的臉。

senses.en: to say or show something in an indirect way
senses.pattern: intimate that… / intimate one's wishes / intimate to sb that…
senses.example: In his speech, the coach [[intimated]] that he might retire after the next season.
senses.example_zh: 教練在演說中暗示，他可能在下個球季結束後退休。

gsat.sentence: They broke into small, [[intimate]] table conversations, recording their insights on paper tablecloths.

senses.en: to live a particular kind of life
senses.pattern: lead a normal life / lead a busy life / lead a healthy lifestyle / lead a double life
senses.example: Thanks to modern medicine, people with diabetes can now [[lead]] active and normal lives.
senses.example_zh: 拜現代醫學之賜，糖尿病患者現在也能過著活躍而正常的生活。

senses.en: a soft, heavy grey metal
senses.pattern: lead poisoning / lead pipes / lead-free paint
senses.example: Old houses may still have [[lead]] pipes, which can make drinking water unsafe for children.
senses.example_zh: 老房子可能還留有鉛管，會使飲用水對兒童不安全。

senses.en: a piece of information that may help solve a crime
senses.pattern: follow up a lead / a promising lead / have no leads
senses.example: Police have received hundreds of phone calls but still have no solid [[leads]] on the missing painting.
senses.example_zh: 警方接到數百通電話，但對於那幅下落不明的畫作仍沒有可靠的線索。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following best describes the life the author is [[leading]]?

senses.en: the lowest level or point reached
senses.pattern: hit a record low / an all-time low / fall to a new low / highs and lows
senses.example: The country's birth rate fell to a record [[low]] last year, worrying many economists.
senses.example_zh: 該國的出生率去年創下新低紀錄，令許多經濟學家憂心。

senses.en: feeling sad and without energy
senses.pattern: feel low / be in low spirits / a low mood
senses.example: Whenever Mia feels [[low]], she calls her grandmother, who always knows how to cheer her up.
senses.example_zh: 每當米雅情緒低落時，就打電話給奶奶，奶奶總是知道怎麼讓她開心起來。

senses.en: to get as much money or advantage as possible
senses.pattern: milk the situation / milk sb for money / milk sth for all it's worth
senses.example: The film studio has [[milked]] the popular series for years by releasing one weak sequel after another.
senses.example_zh: 這家電影公司多年來不斷推出乏善可陳的續集，藉此榨取這個熱門系列的價值。

senses.en: to take milk from a cow or goat
senses.pattern: milk the cows / milk a goat / a milking machine
senses.example: On the school farm trip, each student learned to [[milk]] a goat by hand.
senses.example_zh: 在學校的農場之旅中，每位學生都學會了用手替山羊擠奶。

senses.en: a person who is born good at something
senses.pattern: be a natural / a natural at tennis / a natural on stage
senses.example: Sophie had never acted before, but the director said she was a [[natural]] on stage.
senses.example_zh: 蘇菲以前從未演過戲，但導演說她在舞台上是個天生好手。

senses.en: having a skill or quality from birth
senses.pattern: a natural leader / a natural athlete / a natural talent for music / natural ability
senses.example: Calm and confident under pressure, Aaron is a [[natural]] leader whom the whole team trusts.
senses.example_zh: 亞倫在壓力下沉著又有自信，是個天生的領袖，全隊都信任他。

gsat.sentence: However, according to a wide array of scientific and sociological research, creativity is less a sign of rare genius than a [[natural]] human potential.

senses.en: as soon as; from the moment that
senses.pattern: once you start / once it is done / once opened
senses.example: [[Once]] you understand the basic rule, the rest of the grammar becomes much easier.
senses.example_zh: 一旦你理解了基本規則，其餘的文法就會變得容易許多。
senses.note: once 子句用現在式代替未來式

gsat.sentence: And [[once]] an opinion is formed, most of their thinking then is simply trying to find support for it.
But baby elephants, not used to negotiating rough ground, may easily fall into the trenches and get hurt; and [[once]] injured, they might not be able to climb out.

senses.en: a small group chosen to discuss or judge something
senses.pattern: a panel of experts / a panel of judges / a panel discussion / an interview panel
senses.example: A [[panel]] of five judges will choose the winner of the national science fair.
senses.example_zh: 由五位評審組成的評審團將選出全國科展的優勝者。

gsat.sentence: To be qualified as “extra virgin,” the oil must also pass both an official test in a laboratory and a sensory evaluation by a trained tasting [[panel]].

senses.en: done on a small scale as a test
senses.pattern: a pilot project / a pilot program / a pilot study / a pilot scheme
senses.example: The [[pilot]] study involved only fifty patients, so the doctors plan a much larger trial next year.
senses.example_zh: 這項試驗性的研究只有五十名病患參與，因此醫生們計畫明年進行規模大得多的試驗。

senses.en: to test a new idea on a small scale
senses.pattern: pilot a scheme / pilot a new course / be piloted in schools
senses.example: The bike-sharing service was first [[piloted]] in two districts and later expanded to the whole city.
senses.example_zh: 這項共享單車服務先在兩個行政區試辦，後來才擴大到全市。

senses.en: a person who guides ships into a harbor
senses.pattern: a marine pilot / a harbor pilot / take a pilot on board
senses.example: A local [[pilot]] climbed aboard to guide the huge cargo ship safely through the narrow harbor entrance.
senses.example_zh: 一位當地的領航員登船，引導這艘巨型貨輪安全通過狹窄的港口入口。

gsat.sentence: The [[pilot]] project dedicated to developing the cactus biogas generator began in the south of Mexico City.
This captain is called a marine [[pilot]].

senses.en: to hit something hard again and again
senses.pattern: pound the table / pound the door with one's fists / waves pound the coast
senses.example: Huge waves [[pounded]] the sea wall all night, flooding the road behind it by morning.
senses.example_zh: 巨浪整夜猛擊海堤，到了早上後方的道路已經淹水。

senses.en: (of the heart) to beat very fast and hard
senses.pattern: sb's heart pounds / with a pounding heart / pound with fear
senses.example: My heart was [[pounding]] as I walked onto the stage to give my first speech.
senses.example_zh: 我走上台發表第一次演講時，心臟怦怦跳個不停。

senses.en: to make someone decide to do something
senses.pattern: prompt sb to do sth / prompt a response / prompt concern / prompt an investigation
senses.example: A series of accidents at the crossing [[prompted]] local parents to demand a new traffic light.
senses.example_zh: 路口接連發生事故，促使當地家長要求增設紅綠燈。

senses.en: a question or instruction telling someone what to write
senses.pattern: a writing prompt / an essay prompt / type a prompt / respond to the prompt
senses.example: Students were given a short [[prompt]] and thirty minutes to write a story based on it.
senses.example_zh: 學生拿到一段簡短的提示，並有三十分鐘可以據此寫出一篇故事。

gsat.sentence: Some scholars theorize that onions may have been used for the dead because it was believed that their strong scent would [[prompt]] the dead to breathe again.
RTRI’s new invention [[prompts]] deer to run away.

senses.en: to achieve something you hoped or planned for
senses.pattern: realize a dream / realize one's ambition / realize one's potential / realize a goal
senses.example: With a scholarship from the city, Nora finally [[realized]] her ambition of studying music abroad.
senses.example_zh: 靠著市政府的獎學金，諾拉終於實現了出國學音樂的抱負。
senses.note: 名詞 realization 亦有「實現」之意

gsat.sentence: After years of hard work, Kareem has not only [[realized]] his dream but also transformed a piece of deserted property into a beautiful forest.
We work very hard to [[realize]] this dream.

senses.en: a particular aspect or detail of something
senses.pattern: in this respect / in many respects / in every respect / with respect to
senses.example: The twins look alike, but in most other [[respects]] they are completely different.
senses.example_zh: 這對雙胞胎長得很像，但在其他大多數方面卻截然不同。

senses.en: to obey a law, rule, or agreement
senses.pattern: respect the law / respect the rules / respect the speed limit / respect sb's wishes
senses.example: Hikers must [[respect]] the park's rules and carry all of their trash back down the mountain.
senses.example_zh: 登山客必須遵守公園的規定，把所有垃圾帶下山。

senses.en: to put something in a narrow space between two others
senses.pattern: be sandwiched between A and B / sandwich sth between / be sandwiched in between
senses.example: The tiny bookstore is [[sandwiched]] between a bank and a large department store.
senses.example_zh: 這家小書店被夾在一間銀行和一家大型百貨公司中間。

senses.en: to become aware of something without being told
senses.pattern: sense danger / sense that… / sense sb's presence / sense trouble
senses.example: Dogs can often [[sense]] that an earthquake is coming minutes before people feel anything.
senses.example_zh: 狗往往能在人們有任何感覺的幾分鐘前，就察覺地震即將來臨。

senses.en: one of the meanings of a word or phrase
senses.pattern: in a sense / in the sense that / in the strict sense / in every sense of the word
senses.example: The word "bank" has two [[senses]]: a place for money and the side of a river.
senses.example_zh: bank 這個字有兩個意義：存錢的地方和河岸。

senses.en: good judgment; a sound reason for something
senses.pattern: common sense / make sense / have the sense to do sth / there is no sense in
senses.example: Luckily, Ben had the [[sense]] to turn off the gas before running out of the kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 幸好班夠理智，在跑出廚房前先把瓦斯關掉。

gsat.sentence: None of them wanted to—though for some years afterwards I was left in no doubt that I was morally obliged to them, in the [[sense]] that it always seemed to be my round when it came to the buying of drinks.
If a serious injury is ruled out and the pain is not getting worse after exercising, then the exercise “makes a lot of [[sense]].”

senses.en: large enough to be noticed or have an effect
senses.pattern: a significant increase / a significant amount of / a significant difference / a significant number of
senses.example: The survey found a [[significant]] drop in the number of teenagers who read newspapers.
senses.example_zh: 調查發現，閱讀報紙的青少年人數有顯著的下降。

senses.en: having a special or hidden meaning
senses.pattern: a significant look / a significant glance / a significant smile / a significant pause
senses.example: When I mentioned the surprise party, Mom gave Dad a [[significant]] look and quickly changed the subject.
senses.example_zh: 我一提到驚喜派對，媽媽就意味深長地看了爸爸一眼，隨即轉移話題。

gsat.sentence: The secret is: Never wait until the body is telling you you’re thirsty, since there must already have been [[significant]] changes in your body for it to eventually alert your consciousness.
There is, however, a [[significant]] gap between such beliefs and the actual effect of weather on people’s performance at work.

senses.en: to describe something briefly, without many details
senses.pattern: sketch out a plan / sketch out an idea / sketch the main points
senses.example: In the first meeting, the manager [[sketched]] out her plan for the year without going into detail.
senses.example_zh: 在第一次會議上，經理概述了她今年的計畫，並未深入細節。

senses.en: a short funny scene performed in a show
senses.pattern: a comedy sketch / perform a sketch / write a sketch / a sketch show
senses.example: For the school talent show, our class performed a five-minute comedy [[sketch]] about a forgetful teacher.
senses.example_zh: 在學校才藝表演上，我們班演出了一齣五分鐘的幽默短劇，主角是一位健忘的老師。

senses.en: to move suddenly because of surprise or fear
senses.pattern: start at the noise / start in surprise / start from one's sleep
senses.example: Lost in her book, Amy [[started]] when someone suddenly tapped her on the shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪看書看得入神，有人突然拍她肩膀時，她嚇了一跳。

senses.en: a sudden movement caused by surprise or fear
senses.pattern: wake with a start / give sb a start / sit up with a start
senses.example: I woke with a [[start]] at three in the morning, sure that I had heard footsteps downstairs.
senses.example_zh: 凌晨三點我猛然驚醒，確信自己聽到樓下有腳步聲。

senses.en: to take something away from someone or something
senses.pattern: strip sb of a title / strip sb of power / strip a tree of its leaves / strip off the bark
senses.example: The runner was [[stripped]] of his gold medal after failing a drug test.
senses.example_zh: 這名跑者因藥檢未過，被剝奪了金牌。
senses.note: strip A of B：剝奪 A 的 B

senses.en: a long, narrow piece of land or water
senses.pattern: a strip of land / a narrow strip of beach / a coastal strip
senses.example: The farmers grow rice on a narrow [[strip]] of land between the mountains and the sea.
senses.example_zh: 農民在山與海之間的一塊狹長地帶種稻。

senses.en: a short series of cartoon drawings in a newspaper
senses.pattern: a comic strip / a newspaper strip / a cartoon strip
senses.example: My grandfather still cuts out his favorite comic [[strip]] from the newspaper every morning.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父至今每天早上仍會從報紙上剪下他最愛的連環漫畫。

gsat.sentence: They can quickly [[strip]] fruit trees of their fruit.
As a result, the astronauts have swollen, puffy faces, very much resembling that of the round-headed Charlie Brown in the famous comic [[strip]].

senses.en: a set of facts or numbers arranged in rows
senses.pattern: a table of contents / the table below / a multiplication table / see Table 2
senses.example: The [[table]] on page ten shows how much sugar each popular drink contains.
senses.example_zh: 第十頁的表格列出每種熱門飲料的含糖量。

senses.en: to delay discussing a proposal until later
senses.pattern: table a proposal / table a motion / table a bill / table the discussion
senses.example: Short of time, the student council [[tabled]] the proposal and agreed to discuss it next month.
senses.example_zh: 由於時間不夠，學生會擱置了這項提案，並同意下個月再討論。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式則指「提出討論」

gsat.sentence: When I open a book, I look first at the [[table]] of contents to get a general idea of the book and to see which chapters I might be interested in reading.
I remember that on my cruise I was required to formally plot our course, using the tide [[table]], even though our goal was an island I could see quite clearly across the water in the distance.

senses.en: the pointed or thin end of something
senses.pattern: the tip of the tongue / the southern tip of the island / the tip of the iceberg
senses.example: The lighthouse stands on the northern [[tip]] of the island, where the two seas meet.
senses.example_zh: 燈塔矗立在島嶼的最北端，也就是兩片海域交會之處。

senses.en: to lean or fall to one side
senses.pattern: tip over / tip the chair back / tip the balance / tip the scales
senses.example: The canoe [[tipped]] over when both boys leaned to the same side to look at a turtle.
senses.example_zh: 兩個男孩同時往同一側探身去看烏龜，獨木舟就翻倒了。

gsat.sentence: In 1498, Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama made the first sea voyage to India, via the southernmost [[tip]] of Africa.
According to the analysis, the distance between India’s southern and northern [[tips]] shrinks by 2 cm every year.

senses.en: to examine a person or case in a court
senses.pattern: be tried for theft / try a case / be tried in court
senses.example: The two men were [[tried]] for robbery and sentenced to five years in prison.
senses.example_zh: 這兩名男子因搶劫罪受到審判，並被判處五年徒刑。

senses.en: to test someone's patience to the limit
senses.pattern: try sb's patience / try sb's nerves / be sorely tried
senses.example: The endless delays at the airport really [[tried]] the patience of the tired passengers.
senses.example_zh: 機場沒完沒了的延誤，著實考驗著疲憊旅客的耐心。

senses.en: a sudden increase in an activity or feeling
senses.pattern: a wave of protests / a heat wave / a crime wave / a wave of panic
senses.example: The singer's surprise retirement set off a [[wave]] of sadness among fans around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手無預警引退，在全球歌迷間掀起一波哀傷的情緒。

gsat.sentence: In response to rising demands, these hotels are embracing a [[wave]] of innovation. Instead of the traditional bare pod-sized style, new chains now feature interior design that appeals to digitally connected travelers from around the world.

senses.en: to produce a result, profit, or crop
senses.pattern: yield results / yield a profit / yield a good harvest / yield benefits
senses.example: Three years of careful experiments finally [[yielded]] results that surprised the whole research team.
senses.example_zh: 三年的縝密實驗終於產生了令整個研究團隊驚訝的成果。

senses.en: the amount of crops or profit produced
senses.pattern: crop yields / a high yield / increase the yield / rice yield
senses.example: Scientists are developing new types of wheat that give higher [[yields]] with less water.
senses.example_zh: 科學家正在研發用水更少、產量卻更高的新品種小麥。

gsat.sentence: Yet, it has consistently [[yielded]] many of the world’s best distance runners.
Sax, a proponent of single-sex education, points out that keeping boys and girls separate in the classroom has [[yielded]] striking educational, social, and interpersonal benefits.

quiz.stem: The sharp rise in dengue fever cases this summer has ______ the city government to spray every park and clear blocked drains.
quiz.explain_zh: prompt＝促使。登革熱病例暴增，促使市政府在公園噴藥並清理水溝。

quiz.stem: Because many elderly people in remote villages have never used a smartphone, experts warn that the digital ______ between generations is growing wider.
quiz.explain_zh: divide＝鴻溝、落差。偏鄉長者沒用過智慧型手機，世代間的數位落差擴大。

quiz.stem: Air quality monitors near the factory showed that the ______ of harmful particles was three times higher than the safety standard.
quiz.explain_zh: concentration＝濃度。工廠附近有害微粒的濃度是安全標準的三倍。

quiz.stem: Before introducing the four-day school week nationwide, the ministry ran a ______ program in twenty schools to see how students and teachers would respond.
quiz.explain_zh: pilot＝試辦的。教育部先在二十所學校試辦，觀察師生反應後再全國實施。

quiz.stem: Thanks to better seeds and a new watering system, the small farm ______ nearly twice as many tomatoes this year as it did last year.
quiz.explain_zh: yield＝出產、產生。換了種子和灌溉系統，農場今年出產的番茄幾乎翻倍。

quiz.stem: Although the remake follows the original film closely, it is superior in one important ______: the actors' performances feel far more natural.
quiz.explain_zh: respect＝方面。重拍版在一個重要方面勝過原作：演員的演出自然得多。

quiz.stem: Since last month, large trucks have been ______ from the old bridge because engineers found cracks in its main supports.
quiz.explain_zh: bar＝禁止。工程師發現舊橋的主要支撐結構有裂縫，大卡車被禁止上橋。

quiz.stem: At the technology forum, a ______ of doctors and engineers discussed whether artificial intelligence could safely help diagnose patients.
quiz.explain_zh: panel＝專家小組。論壇上由醫師和工程師組成的小組討論 AI 能否協助診斷。

quiz.stem: The novelist grew up in the fishing port, and her ______ understanding of the fishermen's daily struggles makes her stories feel real.
quiz.explain_zh: intimate＝詳盡的、深入的。小說家在漁港長大，對漁民的辛苦有深入的了解。

quiz.stem: Zoo animals kept in small, empty cages may ______ unusual behaviors, such as walking in circles or biting their own tails.
quiz.explain_zh: exhibit＝表現出。關在狹小空籠裡的動物可能表現出繞圈等異常行為。
